Team OKC
STEAM Volunteer Squad

  • Earn service hours for your organization! (4-H, Girl Scouts, Boy Scouts, National Honor Society, school requirements, etc.)
  • Get service and leadership for college applications and scholarship opportunities! (Really! This is a big deal!)
  • Make an impact in your community!
  • Our students have used team-related projects to earn both Eagle Scout and Girl Scout Gold Awards!

Ways to get Involved:

Mentoring

Help mentor younger robotics teams and their coaches!

Competitions

Help run a FIRST Lego League Competition!

Camps and Workshops

Assist with or lead robot lessons for young students.

Workshop Outreach

Show Science Museum Oklahoma visitors all the cool things that we do with FIRST!

Large Events

Share STEAM at the Tinker Air Show, Tinkerfest, and State Fair.

Sporting Events

Show off robots at STEM outreach days hosted by local professional sports teams.

Requirements

  • Be a member of Oklahoma Countt 4-H / Team OKC Robotics Club
  • Attend training relevant to the type of outreach you are participating in
  • All team members are expected to commit at least 10 hours each year to volunteer work

Opportunities

  • Learn the basics of running and servicing our demonstration robots
  • Learn some basic LEGO Spike Prime robot programming and robot design for camps/workshops
  • Meet lots of fascinating people
